content.short: Quiver provides a React hooks library to integrate Ethereum contracts with dapps using Ethers.js.
content.description: Quiver streamlines Web3 onboarding for both developers and users by offering a curated set of webhooks and UI components that help you assemble usable DApps. It provides a package developers can add with yarn to set up test environments, delivering a functional DApp with connect-wallet controls to support Web3 onboarding. Used by over 22,000 developers, Quiver enables teams to launch DApp boilerplates quickly and consistently, accelerating initial development and experimentation.
